author: Yuri Wong
description:
Learn my techniques to create release-ready tracks: https://musicprosessions.com/the-steal-method

Robert Pattinson is the King of Accents. He's also the King of Weird Choices in Movie Roles. I love that about him. This line:
"Delusions! Blaspheming the Lord in your mind and in your heart for some wrong done to you by another person" and it's delivery, *chefs kiss*

I created the song on the EP40 in about an hour, brought the bits into Logic and took a couple of days to make the final track. All instruments and plugins for the final track were stock Logic, no external effects and instruments used.
